_metadata.description: Mature miRNA sequences for common families used in cross-reactivity analysis. Overhang = last N nt of sequence.
_metadata.warning: PLACEHOLDER — ALL SEQUENCES MUST BE VERIFIED AGAINST miRBase v22+ BEFORE PRODUCTION USE. Sequences below are approximations from training data and may contain errors. Source: miRBase (https://mirbase.org). Arm: 5p unless noted.

let-7._note: PLACEHOLDER — VERIFY WITH MIRBASE v22+. let-7 family differs primarily in positions 17-22 (3' end). Cross-reaction between members reported at 0.1-3.7% (Chen 2005 Figure 7).

miR-17._note: PLACEHOLDER — VERIFY WITH MIRBASE v22+. miR-17 family (oncomiR cluster). Members share CAAAGUGC seed but differ at 3' end.

miR-15._note: PLACEHOLDER — VERIFY WITH MIRBASE v22+. miR-15/16 family — tumor suppressors. Members share AGCACAU seed.

miR-29._note: PLACEHOLDER — VERIFY WITH MIRBASE v22+. miR-29 family — UAGCACC seed. Differ at 3' end region.

miR-200._note: PLACEHOLDER — VERIFY WITH MIRBASE v22+. miR-200 family — two subgroups: 200a/141 and 200b/200c/429. Differ at seed and 3' end.

miR-30._note: PLACEHOLDER — VERIFY WITH MIRBASE v22+. miR-30 family — UGUAAAC seed. Members differ in 3' half.

miR-25._note: PLACEHOLDER — VERIFY WITH MIRBASE v22+. miR-25/32/92 cluster — AUUGCAC seed.
